title: Cloud Storage, Object Lifecycle, and Enterprise File Systems — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces object ingestion and lifecycle tiering: from client upload through Cloud Storage APIs to automated Autoclass transition into Archive cold storage.
routing_rationale: Autoclass dynamically monitors object access frequency, moving inactive data to cheaper Coldline/Archive storage without modifying application code.

nodes.label: Client Application
nodes.detail: Uploads 100MB PDF document invoices into customer bucket.

nodes.label: GCS Regional API
nodes.detail: Validates IAM roles/storage.objectCreator and generates unique object generation ID.

nodes.label: Day 0-30: Standard Tier
nodes.detail: Active customer invoice queried frequently during first month ($0.020/GB).

nodes.label: Day 90: Coldline Tier
nodes.detail: Autoclass transitions object to Coldline ($0.007/GB) after 90 days idle.

nodes.label: Day 365: Archive Tier
nodes.detail: Long-term regulatory archival ($0.0012/GB); sub-second read latency retained.

steps.title: Initial Hot Storage
steps.action: Invoice is uploaded to Standard tier; immediately readable by billing web apps.
steps.why_traversal: Standard class optimizes frequent read throughput without retrieval fees.

steps.title: Coldline Tiering
steps.action: Autoclass observes 90 days without access; moves object storage class to Coldline.
steps.why_traversal: Saves 65% on storage costs while keeping same bucket and object name.

steps.title: Archive Compliance
steps.action: After 1 year, object transitions to Archive class for 7-year regulatory retention.
steps.why_traversal: Achieves lowest possible storage cost ($1.20/TB/month) with sub-second retrieval.

scenarios.label: Coldline Early Deletion Penalty
scenarios.root_cause: Application deleted Coldline object 15 days after transition (min duration is 90 days).
scenarios.diverted_path: Deletion succeeds, but Google Cloud bills remaining 75 days as early deletion fee.
scenarios.recovery: Use Autoclass instead of manual lifecycle rules to automatically manage deletion windows.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Traces object ingestion and lifecycle tiering: from client upload through Cloud Storage APIs to automated Autoclass transition into Archive cold storage.
